name: type7_E_bodychain_funicular_2D_L1600um_eps0.86um
comment: Pore-body chain, 1.6 mm: wall bumps of half-width 30-40 um (grain radius for an assumed 60-80 um median grain diameter; not sourced in the repo, docs/material_parameters.md gives ~50 um without a reference), three throats (50, 70, 45 um) between wide bodies, the last body (1.25-1.6 mm) a dead-end pocket behind the 45 um throat (ink bottle). Ice by one rule only, the equal-curvature fill (build_ice_layout 'fill'): one ice-gas face radius r for the whole pore at the wall-BC angle 60 deg (D1), so ice spans every stretch whose gap is below 2 r cos(60) = r (narrow gaps, throats, opposing grain tips), with faces of radius r; r is set by bisection for the target ice fraction (the fraction jumps with r, so the result can differ from the target; the builder prints it). No ice faces within 200 um of the collector at x = 0. Target 25 %.
